headline: Blackstone Group Buys $3.1 Billion Stake in Mitsubishi's LNG Canada Unit
summary: Funds managed by Blackstone Credit & Insurance and Canadian institutional investors agreed to buy a 49.9% stake in a Mitsubishi Corporation unit holding an interest in LNG Canada for $3.1 billion.
why: Blackstone is one of the world's largest alternative asset managers. LNG Canada is a major liquefied natural gas export infrastructure project in North America.

impacts.name: Blackstone Inc.
impacts.why: Blackstone funds agreed to purchase a 49.9% non-controlling stake in a Mitsubishi unit for $3.1 billion.
